profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer | Building Web and AI-Powered Products at Scale
profile.summary:
Staff-level frontend engineer and former product designer with 18+ years of experience building and scaling high-impact web applications. I work at the intersection of engineering, product, and UX—owning problems end to end, from early concept through production, and focusing on clarity, performance, and real-world outcomes. 

My background spans healthcare, fintech, media, developer tools, and AI-powered products, where I’ve helped teams turn complex requirements into intuitive experiences used at scale.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Drove frontend and full-stack architectural direction for large-scale full-stack platforms, integrating LLM-driven capabilities to enhance both developer productivity and user experience, while defining standards that sustained high availability at millions of daily transactions.
positions.insights: Skills: Next.js · Large Language Models (LLM) · Node.js · Full-Stack Development · GraphQL · TypeScript

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Founded and led a remote team to launch 20+ premium WordPress and Ghost themes, generating 20,000+ sales. Owned the full product lifecycle, from UX/UI design through front-end architecture and delivery.

positions.title: Co-founder
positions.description: Developing an online platform for teaching Product Design and UI/UX.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · Product Design

positions.title: Product Designer & Front-End Engineer
positions.description: Led frontend engineering for an AI-driven platform, shaping intelligent user experiences through rapid experimentation, design-led iteration, and close collaboration with product and go-to-market teams from prototype to production.
positions.insights: Skills: Large Language Models (LLM) · Vue.js · Node.js · Product Design

positions.title: Lead Mobile Applications Developer
positions.description: Designed and built enterprise-grade web and mobile applications supporting nationwide clinical operations, leading cross-functional teams from product ideation through implementation to improve clinician workflows and reduce patient intake time.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Node.js · Product Design · Mobile Applications

positions.title: UX Academy Design Mentor
positions.description: Mentoring students in design fundamentals, interaction design, and UX strategy.

positions.title: Front-End Consultant / Motion Graphics Designer
positions.description: Motion graphics designer and front-end consulting. Designed motion graphics and created front-end CSS animations for HipChat's marketing website.

positions.title: Senior Visual Designer
positions.description: Established a unified design system that standardized UI across web and mobile platforms, partnering closely with engineering to ensure high-fidelity, production-ready implementation at scale.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: I design pretty websites at Brandcast.

positions.title: Front-End Developer Consultant
positions.description: Led the design and development of Edmodo’s developer portal and API documentation, improving clarity, usability, and adoption for external developers.

positions.title: Lead Designer & Developer
positions.description: Directed front-end engineering and design system development for the flagship Ruby on Rails application. Engineered reusable UI components and scalable design patterns, reducing implementation time and improving design consistency across the platform.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · Product Design

positions.title: Web Development Consultant
positions.description: At Bonobo, I was responsible for the redesign and backend development for their corporate website.

honors.title: 2017 Healthcare Innovator of the Year Award Winner
honors.description: Recognized for pioneering EHR (Electronic Health Records) integration in the Matrix Care Plan app.

projects.title: Static Site Boilerplate
projects.description: A better workflow for building modern static websites. Automated build processes, a local development server, production minification and optimizations, and the latest standards for static websites.

projects.title: Leaflet
projects.description: Leaflet is an iPhone app designed for Envato marketplace publishers. Leaflet displays account related information for publishers including comments, earnings breakdown, statement list and push notifications for both new sales and comments.

publications.title: Mind the Gap: Supercharge your PhoneGap workflow
